title: Find the display names of users from the United Kingdom who have posted at
question: Find the display names of users from the United Kingdom who have posted at least one comment with a score of 0 and also authored posts that contain no comments. Additionally, among these users, return only those whose posts have a total favorite count of 4 or more.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_010" FROM comments WHERE "XCL_007" = 0
  )
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_033" FROM posts
    WHERE "XCL_026" NOT IN (SELECT "XCL_006" FROM comments)
  )
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_033" FROM posts GROUP BY "XCL_033" HAVING SUM("XCL_039") >= 4
  )

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM comments AS c
    WHERE c."XCL_010" = T1."XCL_052"
      AND c."XCL_007" = 0
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p."XCL_033" = T1."XCL_052"
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c2
        WHERE c2."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
      )
  )
  AND (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p2."XCL_039"), 0)
    FROM posts AS p2
    WHERE p2."XCL_033" = T1."XCL_052"
  ) >= 4

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH zero_comment_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "XCL_010" AS uid FROM comments WHERE "XCL_007" = 0
),
no_comment_posts AS (
  SELECT "XCL_026" FROM posts WHERE "XCL_026" NOT IN (SELECT "XCL_006" FROM comments)
),
no_comment_authors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "XCL_033" AS uid FROM posts WHERE "XCL_026" IN (SELECT "XCL_026" FROM no_comment_posts)
),
fav AS (
  SELECT "XCL_033" AS uid, SUM("XCL_030") AS total_fav FROM posts GROUP BY "XCL_033"
)
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (SELECT uid FROM zero_comment_users)
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (SELECT uid FROM no_comment_authors)
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (SELECT uid FROM fav WHERE total_fav >= 4)
ORDER BY (SELECT total_fav FROM fav WHERE fav.uid = T1."XCL_052") DESC
LIMIT 1
